newsitem.title: ROMANIA: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 4 PM.
newsitem.headline: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 4 PM.

text.p: * Romanian President Emil Constantinescu met local banking community leaders, saying that the government's planned reform programme could not succeed without a strong banking sector, in which private banks have a significant role to play.
* Romania's Prime Minister Victor Ciorbea met representatives of some 28 banks and companies from the U.S. which invested, or mull investments in Romania.
Ciorbea said the presence of a large number of potential foreign investors showed their confidence in Romania's market.
Ciorbea added that by June the government will improve existing laws on foreign investments.
* The upper Senate resumed debates on the wine and vineyards bill.
